title: Reefer Cargo Services: how setting changes are recorded and charged
content:
## Scope

This calculation guide of **Reefer Cargo Services** explains how an accepted change to the carrying settings is recorded on the service and what it costs, before departure and, on tiers that allow it, after departure.

## Rule

1. Every accepted change is recorded as **one record per change day**; several instructions applied on the same day are one change.
2. **Before departure**, the record is at 0.00 USD while the number of setting-change records already on the service is below the tier's free allowance, and at the tier's setting change fee otherwise.
3. **After departure**, a change (made remotely, on tiers that allow it) is charged at the tier's in-transit setting change fee for each change.
4. The count used in point 2 includes every earlier setting-change record on the service, including those made at 0.00 USD.

## Tier table

| Tier | Free setting changes | Fee per change before departure beyond the free allowance | Fee per remote change after departure |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 1 | 45.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 2 | 40.00 USD | 35.00 USD |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 2 | 60.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 1 | 90.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 0 | 150.00 USD | 75.00 USD |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 1 | 120.00 USD | 0.00 USD |

## Fee for a change before departure: input, judgement, output

- **Input:** the tier, and the number of setting-change records already on the service.
- **Judgement:** is that number below the tier's free allowance?
- **Output:** below the allowance, the change is recorded at 0.00 USD; equal to or above it, the change is recorded at the tier's fee per change before departure.

## Worked sequence (hypothetical AHL Reefer Monitored service)

| Change day | Records already on the service | Before or after departure | Amount recorded |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 March | 0 | Before | 0.00 USD (0 is below the allowance of 2) |
| 4 March | 1 | Before | 0.00 USD (1 is below 2) |
| 6 March | 2 | Before | 40.00 USD (2 is not below 2) |
| 15 March | 3 | After (remote) | 35.00 USD |

## Further hypothetical cases

> **Same-day instructions.** On AHL Reefer Standard, the shipper sends two written instructions on 8 April, one for the set point and one for ventilation. They are one change, recorded once for that day. With no earlier record, it is inside the free allowance of 1 and recorded at 0.00 USD.

> **No free allowance.** On AHL Reefer Pharma GDP the free allowance is 0, so even the first change before departure is recorded at 150.00 USD.

## Basis Q&A

**Why record a change at 0.00 USD at all?** Every accepted change is recorded, and the free allowance is measured by counting those records.

**Is the in-transit fee reduced by any free allowance?** The free allowance is stated for changes before departure; after departure each remote change is charged at the tier's in-transit fee.
